propositions: Structurally divergent LLM provider responses can normalize to empty verification outcomes that are incorrectly treated as valid review results.

Two distinct paths produce semantically empty verification results: raw-empty (provider returns empty list) and malformed-to-empty (provider returns non-empty output that is entirely dropped during reshape).
Decision layer already treats any finding with no verification entry as indeterminate, preventing semantically empty results from producing valid pass/fail outcomes.
Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) to track verification pipeline health and provider variation handling.
Resilient parsing and bounded retry behavior must remain provider-independent while explicitly rejecting empty outcomes after recovery attempts.
Pipeline-level telemetry wiring in plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is not yet connected to kernel-level outcome_counts buckets.
